_comment: Externalized decision thresholds for the Daily Top 5 advisor.
This file is the single source of truth for every gate the pipeline applies.
Previously these were hardcoded inline in per-run build-analysis.py, which meant
each nightly run silently re-authored its own thresholds.
Source of truth per prompt contract section 3: the daily-top5-advisor SKILL.md

_min_hard_note: Relaxed from 2 to 1 on 2026-10-01. This was only possible after hard
indicator #2 was re-scoped: the old #2 fired 0 times in 3 years on any
name other than two M&A-pinned stocks, so requiring two hard indicators
was unsatisfiable. Re-run the replay in scripts/replay_gate.py before

_definition_note: REPLACED 2026-10-01. The old rule required price within 1.5% of the
161.8% extension of the 60-day impulse. A 161.8% extension sits 61.8%
ABOVE the impulse-leg high, so the level was above price in 100% of
17,675 measured symbol-days (median gap 14.02%). The old rule could
therefore only fire when price was at a new high -- the exact
opposite of the pullback entry it was meant to detect.
New rule: price has pulled back INTO the confluence band formed
between the impulse-leg high and the 161.8% extension, and is holding
hard_2_fib_confluence_band._max_band_depth_note: How far below band_low price may pull back and still count as a retest.

_s_rev_note: bars, which the pipeline never fetched. It was hardwired False while
still being rendered as an evaluated 0-point row, which misrepresented
an uncollected indicator as a genuine non-hit.
Re-enable only if collect-evidence.py actually pulls 30s bars.

position_sizing._sector_flag_note: Standing risk rule: flag (do not silently accept) any sector above this share of the portfolio after the proposed fill.
position_sizing._note: Standing risk rule. Unchanged. Not a defect -- see the capital-to-strategy mismatch in the 2026-10-01 diagnostic.
_fractional_requires_note: CORRECTED 2026-10-01. The pipeline previously required an asset-level
return that field -- it only appears as a STRING inside the `attributes`
array. The check read 'absent' for all 25 qualifiers on every run, so
fractional was permanently and silently disabled. Real capability is
per-asset fractionable. Both are now asserted explicitly and a missing
field raises instead of defaulting to whole shares.

expected_indicator_values._note: Fields the pipeline MUST obtain. Any missing value is a hard error, never a silent default.
